policy.notes: Week 2 can be built almost entirely with original SVG diagrams. ArcGIS screenshots will be supplied by the instructor after testing the current interface.
policy.screenshot_naming_notes: Instructor screenshots may use any descriptive filename. The file paths in this manifest are preferred canonical names only. After screenshots are added to Drive, map or rename them during ingestion before publishing.
policy.external_media_notes: For third-party photos/videos, prefer linking or embedding from the original/official source. Download/rehost only when licensing clearly permits it and attribution requirements are recorded.
policy.legacy_media_notes: Keep URLs/provenance for engaging legacy visuals even when the rewritten Week 2 lecture uses original SVG replacements. A DROP_FROM_CORE decision does not delete the source from the manifest.
policy.perception_demo_reuse_rule: For legacy perception slides credited to Jeffrey Shaffer, Beau Lotto, or other third parties, reuse the perceptual principle with original course geometry/interaction unless a specific open license is verified. Historic public-domain figures may be linked or embedded with source attribution.
policy.misleading_visualization_reuse_rule: For legacy misleading-graph or infographic examples, preserve the teaching principle and external source URL. Prefer original course recreations or synthetic examples; do not copy broadcast screenshots or third-party infographic artwork unless a reusable license is verified.
